notes.meaning: Human effort accomplishes nothing without the blessing of God. Builders can assemble a physical house and guards can patrol the city walls, but true safety and lasting success come only from the Lord. Believers must still do their daily work, but they must trust in God's providence rather than their own strength.

other.label: Catholic
other.view: Early teachers like Augustine saw this as Christ building his spiritual house, the church, while ministers serve as builders and watchmen.

notes.meaning: Working endless hours from early morning until late at night cannot guarantee security when driven by worry. Anxious toil wears people down, but God wants his people to be free from fretful striving. He grants peaceful rest and quiet provision to those he loves.

Children are not a burden or an accident of nature, but a precious gift from the Lord. Just as an inheritance is handed down freely rather than earned as wages, God gives children out of his own grace and kindness. Building a family is one of the clearest ways God blesses a household.

Children born to young parents grow up to become their strength and protection, like arrows in the hand of a skilled warrior. When parents grow older, these grown children can stand up to defend and support them. Parents must also carefully guide and shape their children early so they aim toward God's purposes.

other.label: Catholic
other.view: Augustine interpreted these arrows as the apostles, who were sent out into the world by Christ to conquer hearts for God.

notes.meaning: A person with a home full of supportive children is truly blessed. In the ancient world, the city gate was the public court where legal disputes were settled. Grown children would stand beside their aging parents there, protecting them from being cheated or bullied by their opponents.

differ.view: Couples should avoid birth control and trust God to give them as many children as possible.
Children are always a gift from God, but families may wisely use birth control to plan their family size.
